title: Real Open Data reproducibility case: Japan enterprise count 2021 -> 2024 from published Economic Census aggregates

input.researchQuestion: Is the number of companies in Japan really declining between 2021 and 2024?

datasets.description: Published enterprise-equivalent count from the 2021 Economic Census for Business Activity. See reports/japan-company-count-2021-2024/normalized.csv (row 1) and README.md for the source PDF.

Published enterprise-equivalent count from the 2024 Economic Census Basic Survey A (甲調査), which excludes individual proprietorship establishments with no employees. See reports/japan-company-count-2021-2024/normalized.csv (row 2).

2024 reference table (参考表) that adds the segment excluded from the Basic Survey A back in by carrying forward the 2021 value for individual proprietorships with no employees. Retrieval, sheet, row and checksum are recorded in reports/japan-company-count-2021-2024/ACQUISITION.md.

expectations.text: If the apparent decline is mostly a population-definition change, harmonizing the 2024 population should shrink the gap toward zero or reverse it.

hypotheses.text: The number of companies genuinely declined between 2021 and 2024.
Most of the apparent -30.8% drop is caused by the 2024 survey excluding individual proprietorships with no employees.

evidence.summary: The 2024 Basic Survey A explicitly excludes individual proprietorship establishments with no employees, so the naive 2021-2024 delta is not a like-for-like population comparison.
On the harmonized population the decline shrinks from -30.8% (-1,134,222) to -9.0% (-332,030).
A residual -9.0% remains after harmonization, so the population-definition change alone does not explain the entire naive gap.

requiredLimitations: The 2021 and 2024-published enterprise-equivalent populations are not definitionally identical; the -30.8% figure must not be presented as a company decline.
The harmonized 2024 value carries the 2021 no-employee-individual segment forward; it is a reference value, not an observed 2024 measurement.
Whether the residual -9.0% reflects a real decline within the surveyed population versus other reporting or threshold changes is not identified.

requiredResearchGaps.need: An observed 2024 count of individual proprietorships with no employees, instead of a value carried forward from 2021.
2022 and 2023 enterprise counts under a single consistent population definition.
An explanation for the 64,378 gap between the two published 2024 company-enterprise tables (結果の概要 表II-1 vs 参考表 第2表).

forbiddenClaims: 日本の会社は減っている
会社の数が減少したことが確認された

humanReview.notes: Reproduce with: python3 scripts/public_evidence_report.py --input reports/japan-company-count-2021-2024/normalized.csv --out-dir reports/japan-company-count-2021-2024/generated. A passing report must label the naive comparison NOT_COMPARABLE, must not call the harmonized pair COMPARABLE, and must not claim a resolved decline.
